t.en: On the proof board, the two equations of <level-ref to="def-plus"></level-ref>, 0 + y = y and S x + y = S (x + y), are two “for all” givens.
t.zh: <level-ref to="def-plus"></level-ref>的两条等式 0 + y = y、S x + y = S (x + y)，在证明板上是两句「对所有」的已知。

brief.en: From the two definitions of addition, prove 1 + 1 = 2.
brief.zh: 从加法的两条定义证出 1 + 1 = 2。

hint.en: Start with <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>, putting particular numbers for the x and y of a definition.
hint.zh: 先用<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>，把定义里的 x、y 换成具体的数。

hint.en: The second definition gives S (0 + S 0); the first works out 0 + S 0, which Rewrite then puts in.
hint.zh: 第二条定义给出 S (0 + S 0)；第一条算出 0 + S 0，再用等量代换换进去。
